title: Crispy Chia Wontons
description: A crispy Chinese-inspired snack with a crunchy wonton crust and a chia seed filling. Perfect as a snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: Umami flaky pastry dough (homemade or store-bought)

instructions: Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out squares of dough, about 3 inches per side.
In a small bowl, mix together chia seeds and olive oil.
Place a small spoonful of the chia seed mixture onto the center of each dough square.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle or a square shape, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the wontons with a little bit of olive oil and sprinkle with crumble sugar.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
